description: This is a PHP class representing an employee's emergency contact details within an HR management system, including properties like name, relationship, and contact numbers, along with ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContact
classes.description: Entity class for employee emergency contact details, mapped to the database table 'hs_hr_emp_emergency_contacts'. This class uses ORM annotations for persistence and includes methods for accessing and modifying contact details.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this emergency contact.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object associated with this emergency contact.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of this emergency contact.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number for this emergency contact.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship of the emergency contact to the employee.

methods.name: setRelationship
methods.description: Sets the relationship of the emergency contact.
